adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies a real bug in the transaction ordering. Looking at addGuests.handler.ts, the code at line 92 calls `prisma.booking.update()` to persist new guests to the database, then later at line 165 calls `eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking)`. If the calendar update fails, the database already has the guests persisted. On retry, the `uniqueGuests` filter at lines 72-76 will filter out the already-added guests (since they're now in booking.attendees), resulting in `uniqueGuests.length === 0` which throws an error at line 78. This leaves the system in an inconsistent state where guests are in the database but not in the calendar, and retries won't fix it.
